response.overview: Japan, with its immense socio-cultural heritage, has long been a source of fascination for the Western world. Yet this country still holds many great mysteries. One of them is linked to the kofun—imposing megalithic burial mounds, often built as tumuli or in the distinctive keyhole shape. Historically as significant as the Egyptian pyramids, they remain largely unknown. Neapolitan archaeologist Daniele Petrella leads an international archaeological mission to study them. In the heart of the forest of Okayama, he oversees the excavation of the Tobiotsuka Kofun and later travels to other Japanese cities where some of the most important tombs are located. This documentary aims to reveal the kofun to the world and reconstruct their historical and social significance.
response.title: Kofun
